text:
olga petrov: Heads-up — trying the Llama eval starter (Next.js + LangChain + LlamaIndex) and hitting auth/retry weirdness on Edge.
samir: same here. initial call to /api/eval returns 401 when token rotates then client retries but Authorization header gone on retry.
jen: looks like sdk-edge's retry rebuilds Request without merging ephemeral headers. sdk-js preserved them.
mike: filed infra ticket 4019 and added a tiny repro harness: https://git.redwood/infra/issues/4019
devex-bot: issue 4019 created by mike — labels: bug, sdk-edge
olga petrov: immediate fix for sample: add an explicit header merge in the helper and document it in README "Edge auth note". new users copy helper and get blocked.
samir: suggested snippet:
```
const headers = new Headers(orig.headers);
if (ctx?.token) headers.set('authorization', `Bearer ${ctx.token}`);
const retryReq = new Request(orig.url, { method: orig.method, headers, body: await orig.clone().arrayBuffer() });
```
jen: adding a CI smoke test under samples/e2e that simulates token expiry and asserts <=2 attempts. will catch regressions.
mike: opening hotfix PR to starter repo to include helper + README note and bump sdk-edge once fix lands.
olga petrov: thanks — also adding one-line to onboarding checklist: "If Edge starter sees repeated 401s, ensure helper sets Authorization explicitly or upgrade sdk-edge." :white_check_mark:
